description: Khabor’s Waystation lies before you. Roma and his Enforcers explore the catacombs beneath. The Order has installed a magickal barrier to keep people out. Find a way to get inside! With Sicilus and Tinny's help you may be able to tear the barrier down and get inside before it's too late.
name: Cradle and Coffin

objectives.typeextra: Follow Tinny's plan to destroy the barrier
